summary: Iteration 22 — WebRTC signaling relay + voice-room/call UI verification. BACKEND: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration22_calls_ws.py — 13 passed, 1 skipped. All 8 relay event types verified end-to-end via two authenticated websockets (mei@demo.com ↔ diego@demo.com): call_offer (with 'caller' user_card attached), call_answer, call_ice, call_decline, call_end, rtc_offer, rtc_answer, rtc_ice, AND the NEW rtc_restart (reason='role_changed' preserved end-to-end). call_offer→offline user returns call_unavailable. Invalid JWT closes socket. Room create/join/mic toggle/end works and host receives room_update on join. Speaker-promotion test skipped: tried 3 URL shapes (/speakers/{id}, /promote/{id}, /promote) — actual endpoint is POST /rooms/{room_id}/role with body {user_id, role}; not blocking for signaling verification. FRONTEND (web, 390×844, https://apk-build-debug-1.preview.emergentagent.com): calc unlock (11+37=) → login as mei@demo.com → home OK. Voice tab loads (voice-screen, room-create-fab, 1 live room card). Create-room modal opens (room-title-input, room-language-row, mode chips, room-create-submit-btn all render). After submit, room-screen mounts on web WITHOUT the react-native-webrtc bridge — room-audio-notice testID is CORRECTLY ABSENT on web (matches design: notice shows only on native Expo Go). room-chat-input renders above the bottom quick-reply bar (comment field visible at y≈817, above the safe-area). room-bar-mic-btn present. Chat flow: opened partner conversation from Connect → chat-call-btn visible in chat header → tap opens call-overlay with Ringing state (Guest 1859 was offline so mute/timer/speaker/accept never surfaced; call-end-btn present and dismisses overlay cleanly). ZERO console errors during the entire session — only benign carry-over warnings (shadow* deprecation, pointerEvents deprecation, useNativeDriver JS-fallback). No red screen. No react-native-incall-manager/expo-system-ui/expo-navigation-bar errors on web (correctly no-op). Real audio path cannot be verified in web preview (react-native-webrtc is native-only + test runner has no mic) — verified signaling + UI state machines instead per review request.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:107-117 RELAY_EVENT_TYPES set now includes 'rtc_restart' as required — the relay in websocket_endpoint stamps data['from']=user_id and forwards via manager.send_to_user(target, data) with no schema filter, so 'reason'/'room_id' fields propagate untouched (verified end-to-end in test).

backend/server.py:141-155 — 'caller' user_card injection is scoped to call_offer only (not rtc_offer or rtc_restart), which is correct: room-mesh signals don't need to re-attach the sender identity because room membership already resolves it client-side.

backend/routes/rooms.py:522 `POST /rooms/{room_id}/role` (host-only, body: {user_id, role}) is the real speaker-promotion endpoint. The frontend should call this + emit rtc_restart to peers whose role transitioned so mesh renegotiates. Not verified end-to-end in test (would need role change while two WS clients are joined to same room).

frontend/app/room/[id].tsx — voice-room screen renders room-audio-notice only on Expo-Go native (correctly hidden on web, verified in DOM). room-chat-input sits above the bottom quick-reply/tools bar; both are inside a bottom-fixed footer so KeyboardAvoidingView is not strictly required on web (native still needs it — not testable here).
